data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ioseph, meaning 'God will add'. Josy is a diminutive of Joseph and is popular as a girl's name in various cultures. In Christianity, Joseph is the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine assistance and protection.

biblical_reference.note: Joseph is a major figure in the Hebrew Bible, known for his coat of many colors, his dreams, and his status as a slave and a ruler in Egypt.

data.cultural_impact: Josy is a name deeply rooted in various Christian communities, particularly those of European origin. While it's a diminutive of Joseph, it's popularly used as a standalone name for girls. It holds cultural significance as a reminder of the important role Joseph played in the Christian faith as the spouse of Mary, and the foster father of Jesus.
data.spiritual_significance: As a diminutive of Joseph, the name Josy holds deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It's a reminder that, as the name implies, God will add to our lives in countless ways. In the Christian faith, this can be understood through the example of Saint Joseph who, though a humble carpenter, was chosen to be the guardian and protector of Jesus and Mary. Through the name Josy, we are called to trust in God's divine plan for our lives and to remain open to the many blessings and graces he bestows upon us.
